topic: Introduction to helicopter, difference between fixed wing and rotary wing, history of helicopter, development, different rotor systems
syllabus_extract: Introduction to helicopter, difference between fixed wing and rotary wing, history of helicopter, development, different rotor systems.
specific_objectives: 13.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the helicopter control, main rotor movements, translation flight, power, auto rotation, vibration checks and various adjustments.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of IB diagrams regarding rotor systems; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a helicopter's main rotor?
Can you name one major difference between fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft?
Who is credited with the first successful powered helicopter flight?

development.content:
Introduction to Helicopter
Fixed Wing vs Rotary Wing
History of Helicopter
Development Timeline

Different Rotor Systems
Types of Rotor Configurations
Rotor System Components
Advantages of Various Systems

Summary of Rotor Systems
Key Historical Milestones
Comparison of Wing Types
Future Development Trends

summary_questions: Explain the fundamental difference in lift generation between fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft.
Identify two key historical milestones in helicopter development.
Describe the basic components of a typical rotor system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the operational characteristics of fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft, focusing on flight control mechanisms, to be discussed in the next lesson plan regarding shaft axis and rotation.

pft_rows.syllabus: Definition of shaft axis, axis rotation, plane of rotation tip path plane, blade pitch, rotor thrust, relative air flow, coning angle, limit of RPM.
